result.question: What do groups not serving on Sabbath do?

readings.answer: They guard the house of the LORD for the king.
readings.support: the two divisions that would go off duty on the Sabbath are to guard the house of the LORD

assessments.reason: Verse 7 explicitly says the divisions that go off duty on the Sabbath "are to guard the house of the LORD," which is equivalent to guarding Yahweh’s house; adding "for the king" does not change the core action.

result.reason: The passage states that those going off duty on the Sabbath are to guard the house of the LORD.
